measures.title: NYC Proposal 1 (Public space consents)
measures.summary: Speed up approval of revocable consents to use public space (ramps, cafes, benches): public hearings become optional and the Council can no longer reject sidewalk cafe permits

measures.title: NYC Proposal 2 (Contractor paperwork)
measures.summary: Let the Procurement Policy Board simplify contractor questionnaires and require it to meet at least quarterly

measures.title: NYC Proposal 3 (Street safety, city property, leasing)
measures.summary: Streamline approvals for street safety projects, sale or lease of certain city property, and office leases for city workers

measures.title: NYC Proposal 4 (Building permits)
measures.summary: Create a central construction permit system and move waterfront permitting from Small Business Services to the Department of Buildings

measures.title: NYC Proposal 5 (Rainy day fund)
measures.summary: Set a reserve target of at least 12% of the prior year's tax revenue and require a published deposit plan

10001.measuresNote: NYC Charter Proposals 1–5 are on the ballot (already in the data; titles match the NYC BOE contest list). Neither the NYC BOE contest list for New York County nor the NYS certification lists any statewide ballot proposal; verify on your sample ballot at findmypollsite.vote.nyc.
